🇲🇽📊 <u>Bank Lending to Mexican Businesses Picks Up: +5.6% in September</u>

Banxico data show commercial bank credit to the private sector grew 5.6% in real annual terms in September, up from 4.0% in August. Lending to companies jumped from 2.0% to 5.4%. Consumer credit grew 8.4%, and credit cards rose 12.3%.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>Carlos Manzo Case: Uruapan Welfare Secretary Arrested for Cover-Up</u>

On October 29, Michoacán's state prosecutor arrested Rosa Alejandra Vargas Rauda, Uruapan's municipal welfare secretary, for allegedly covering up the murder of former mayor Carlos Manzo. She had been summoned three times. She is the mother of "El Macas," one of Manzo's bodyguards who is in custody, and the aunt of "El Vikingo" and "El Brilloso," who are also accused in the killing. The arrest came days before the first anniversary of the November 1, 2025 murder.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Sheinbaum to Those Who Say 2027 Is "In Doubt": "They'll Bite Their Tongues"</u>

Sheinbaum answered critics who say the 2027 election is at risk after the INE contracting scandal. She said the network of companies behind it, Cajas Graf, Formas Finas, Corporativo ZEG, Comercializadora JVLY and Seriplast, has been winning contracts since the 1990s, long before Morena existed. The cleanup is meant to fix "not today's INE, the one that comes from far back." Her proposal is for Talleres Gráficos de México, the state printer, to print the electoral ballots and paperwork.

🇲🇽🏠 <u>Mexico City Expropriates Buildings in Roma, Centro and Narvarte for Social Housing</u>

The capital's government issued an expropriation decree and two public-utility declarations covering structurally unsafe buildings at Monterrey 376 in Roma Sur, Luz Saviñón 1065 in Narvarte Poniente and Roldán 100 in the Centro. The housing institute (Invi) will build social housing there, and the people who live in the buildings now will get the new homes. These are the neighborhoods where gentrification has been pushing tenants out.
banner: CDMX: SOCIAL HOUSING IN ROMA AND NARVARTE

🇲🇽🎓 <u>Sheinbaum Opens a Free Public University Campus in Rural Hidalgo</u>

The Universidad Nacional Rosario Castellanos now has a campus in Tecozautla, Hidalgo. About 300 students are already enrolled in four degrees, including Medicine, Law and Criminology, and Community Tourism. Sheinbaum announced a School of Medicine and two more buildings. She called education "the heart of the transformation": a right, not a business, so no young person drops out for lack of money.
banner: HIDALGO: FREE UNIVERSITY, MED SCHOOL NEXT

🇲🇽📊 <u>Afore Fee Cap Falls Again: 0.53% in 2027</u>

Consar's governing board unanimously capped what Mexico's pension fund managers (Afores) can charge workers in 2027 at 0.53% of balances, or 5.30 pesos per 1,000. That's the third straight cut, from 0.55% in 2025 and 0.54% in 2026. Before AMLO's 2020 pension reform, the average fee was 0.90%. Nine of the ten Afores charge the maximum allowed. The only one that has historically charged less is PensionISSSTE, the public one. (El Economista)

🇲🇽🏥 <u>IMSS Starts Delivering New Equipment to 39 Hospitals</u>

IMSS has begun distributing 47 pieces of specialized medical equipment to 39 hospitals in 19 states: 20 3D ultrasound machines, 17 electrocardiographs and 10 vital-signs monitors. It's the first batch of a planned purchase of 2,917 pieces of equipment, part of the institute's "12 actions in 120 days" emergency plan. IMSS director Zoé Robledo announced it at Friday's mañanera. Hospitals in Chihuahua, Jalisco, Nuevo León, Oaxaca, Sonora, Quintana Roo, the State of Mexico and Guanajuato are among the first to get it.

🇲🇽🕯️ <u>Sheinbaum: Day of the Dead Is Mexico's Legacy of Greatness</u>

Sheinbaum used Friday's mañanera to defend Day of the Dead against decades of cultural import. "On each Day of the Dead our ancestors come to visit us, to be with us," she said. It's an Indigenous worldview that sees continuity between life and death, unlike the Western one. For years Halloween and US cultural influence pushed the tradition aside, and the neoliberal period taught Mexicans to be ashamed of who they are. Now, she said, 90% of Mexicans say they're proud to be Mexican, and the giant catrina in the Zócalo is there so kids grow up with their own customs.
banner: DAY OF THE DEAD: 90% PROUD MEXICANS

🇲🇽🏠 <u>Veracruz Ranks Fifth in Mexico for Building Social Housing</u>

Under Sheinbaum's national housing program, built by Infonavit and Conavi with state and local governments, Veracruz is now fifth in the country for social-housing construction. Governor Rocío Nahle's administration has also regularized 796 properties and handed out 290 property deeds, giving families legal title to their homes. Nahle says her main demand is that the new homes go up in municipalities with real infrastructure and urban planning, instead of the empty developments built far from everything under the old Infonavit model.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>ICE Agent Charged for Running Over a Mexican Worker in Houston</u>

A Harris County grand jury has charged ICE agent Mario Alberto Morales with aggravated assault with a deadly weapon (his car) for running down Mexican construction worker Miguel Parra Hernández, 48, on October 10. ICE said Parra ran in front of the vehicle and called the charge "a political maneuver." Surveillance video shows an unmarked Jeep Cherokee jumping a median and accelerating toward him while he ran on foot. District Attorney Sean Teare says the video clearly contradicts ICE's version. Parra is still in ICE custody, recovering from multiple fractures. Mexico's Foreign Ministry had demanded a full investigation.
